title: coelogyne erectilabia
intro: Coelogyne erectilabia, commonly known as the 'Tall Coelogyne', is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Asia. This plant is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne erectilabia include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm these claims.
